notes: TEST BUILD — PR #17 (fix/sensu-continuous-gesture), pushed to the updater at Michael's request. Selection now follows the fan as it opens: the slice drawn under your thumb is the one selected, and the highlight tracks the bloom even if your thumb stays still. Landing on the brightness/volume rim no longer jumps the value — it only changes once you slide along the rim. Releasing on the rim does not fire a slice, and the centre is a dead zone.
